scientific_integrity: Complete feedback-map and independently implemented Euler-circuit enumerations verify the finite population and histogram, with independently computed discrepancies. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for cyclic binary de Bruijn sequences of order five, up to cyclic rotation; does not prove all-order discrepancy bounds or limiting distributions. The general binary minimum equal to the order is already known; historical priority of exact multiplicities is provisional.
title: Complete circular-discrepancy distribution of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
